story_type: schooner in 20-foot seas, swimmer and two helicopters
narration: Twenty-foot seas, fifty-knot winds, and a schooner taking on water with six aboard.
They were ninety miles out, a long way from home for a Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter.
Then the rescue swimmer dropped into the sea.
In big seas, people jump one at a time, and the swimmer catches them on the hook.
Fuel was tight, so a second Dolphin came.
outcome: Between the two helicopter crews, all six people were picked up out of the sea.
title: Schooner sinking in 20-foot seas
description:
On June 19, 2021, the disabled 79-foot sailboat Barlovento was taking on water in 20-foot seas about 90 miles off Crescent City, California. Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin crews from Sector Humboldt Bay and Sector North Bend rescued all six people aboard.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Brandon Giles, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/807100/california-oregon-coast-guard-crews-rescue-6-people-sinking-sailboat-90-miles-offshore-crescent-city
